name: Erika's Oddish
flavorText: When it is woken by moonlight, it wanders about. But during the day, it stays still underground.

name: Erika's Gloom
flavorText: It secretes a sticky, drool-like nectar. Though sweet, it smells too repulsive to get very close.

name: Erika's Bellsprout
flavorText: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

name: Erika's Weepinbell
flavorText: It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of acid.

name: Erika's Victreebel
flavorText: Once taken into Victreebel's body, even the hardest object will be melted into nothing by the Pokémon's acid.

name: Erika's Tangela
flavorText: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.

name: Chikorita
flavorText: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up sun rays.

name: Bayleef
flavorText: The spicy aroma emanating from around its neck has an energizing effect.

name: Wurmple
flavorText: It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a Starly, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.

name: Silcoon
flavorText: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.

name: Beautifly
flavorText: Vibrantly patterned wings are its prominent feature. It sucks sweet flower nectar with its long mouth.

name: Cascoon
flavorText: Its body, which is made of soft silk, hardens over time. When cracks appear, evolution is near.

name: Dustox
flavorText: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.

name: Budew
flavorText: The pollen it releases contains poison. If this Pokémon is raised on clean water, the poison's toxicity is increased.

name: Grubbin
flavorText: It spits sticky thread and winds them around branches, then swings nimbly from tree to tree in a pendulum-like motion.

name: Team Rocket's Tarountula
flavorText: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon's natural enemy.

name: Team Rocket's Spidops
flavorText: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

name: Charmander
flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

name: Charmeleon
flavorText: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

name: Ethan's Slugma
flavorText: Its lava body can cool and chip away at times, but a magma bath will heal it right up.

name: Ethan's Magcargo
flavorText: This Pokémon lives near the craters of volcanoes. It stores fire energy in its shell of cooled and hardened magma.

name: Entei
flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

name: Numel
flavorText: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

name: Camerupt
flavorText: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years—or whenever it becomes really angry.

name: Tepig
flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

name: Pignite
flavorText: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.

name: N's Darumaka
flavorText: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it's pushed or pulled.

name: N's Darmanitan
flavorText: This Pokémon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Salandit
flavorText: Only female Salandit can produce gas laden with pheromones. Males entranced by this gas will do whatever the females tell them.

name: Salazzle
flavorText: When two Salazzle meet, they will use their pheromone gas to fight over the males in each other's group.

name: Scorbunny
flavorText: Fire energy gathers in the pads of its feet, raising their temperature. Once hot, Scorbunny's footpads can deal heavy damage to opponents.

name: Raboot
flavorText: While it prides itself on its varied kicking moves, it can also deliver powerful headbutts once its flames have heated up its forehead.

name: Psyduck
flavorText: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

name: Golduck
flavorText: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

name: Totodile
flavorText: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: Croconaw
flavorText: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

name: Sneasel
flavorText: This is a smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.

name: Weavile
flavorText: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.

name: Snorunt
flavorText: In some snowy lands, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a Snorunt lives there.

name: N's Vanillite
flavorText: The temperature of their breath is -58 degrees Fahrenheit. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

name: N's Vanillish
flavorText: They cool down the surrounding air and create ice particles, which they use to freeze their foes.

name: N's Vanilluxe
flavorText: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard from its horn, burying everything in snow.

name: Snom
flavorText: Within its internal organs, Snom amplifies the frigid air it gets from eating snow and then uses this amplified air to create icicle-like spikes.

name: Frosmoth
flavorText: It causes blizzards as it flies around with its huge, chill-emanating wings. Clean meltwater is its favorite thing to drink.

name: Glastrier
flavorText: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It's also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.

name: Pikachu
flavorText: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. When in a tough spot, this Pokémon discharges electricity.

name: Raichu
flavorText: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

name: Tynamo
flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

name: Eelektrik
flavorText: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

name: Stunfisk
flavorText: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.

name: Helioptile
flavorText: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

name: Heliolisk
flavorText: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

name: Charjabug
flavorText: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

name: Vikavolt
flavorText: When carrying a Charjabug, Vikavolt can receive electricity from it and then rapidly fire powerful electromagnetic beams from its large jaws.

name: Tapu Koko
flavorText: Although it's called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.

name: Iono's Tadbulb
flavorText: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

name: Iono's Wattrel
flavorText: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

name: Iono's Kilowattrel
flavorText: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

name: Clefairy
flavorText: On nights with a full moon, they gather together and dance. The surrounding area is enveloped in an abnormal magnetic field.

name: Clefable
flavorText: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.

name: Team Rocket's Exeggcute
flavorText: Using telepathy only fellow Exeggcute can pick up on, they always form a cluster of six.

name: Team Rocket's Exeggutor
flavorText: It is said that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

name: Togepi
flavorText: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

name: Togetic
flavorText: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

name: Togekiss
flavorText: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they've hardly been seen at all.

name: Marill
flavorText: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it's fine even in rivers with strong currents.

name: Misdreavus
flavorText: It loves to bite and yank people's hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

name: Mismagius
flavorText: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

name: Ralts
flavorText: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people's emotions.

name: Kirlia
flavorText: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

name: Shuppet
flavorText: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.

name: Banette
flavorText: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

name: Rotom
flavorText: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

name: Swirlix
flavorText: To entangle and immobilize its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.

name: Slurpuff
flavorText: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

name: Hop's Phantump
flavorText: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.

name: Hop's Trevenant
flavorText: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest. It's kind to the Pokémon that reside in its body.

name: Team Rocket's Mimikyu
flavorText: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

name: Spectrier
flavorText: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn't use its sense of sight. Spectrier's kicks are said to separate soul from body.

name: Munkidori
flavorText: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

name: Team Rocket's Diglett
flavorText: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.

name: Team Rocket's Dugtrio
flavorText: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

name: Hitmontop
flavorText: It spins on its horn while dealing out elegant kicks. Its horn grows continuously through its lifetime.

name: Meditite
flavorText: It meditates in order to build up its mental energy. It eats just one berry a day.

name: Medicham
flavorText: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's movements.

name: Lunatone
flavorText: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

name: Solrock
flavorText: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

name: Groudon
flavorText: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.

name: Cynthia's Gible
flavorText: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

name: Cynthia's Gabite
flavorText: In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales. Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient will make a weary body feel invigorated.

name: Riolu
flavorText: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

name: Pancham
flavorText: It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face, but it can't help grinning if anyone pats its head.

name: Carbink
flavorText: Born from the high temperatures and pressures deep underground, it releases energy from the stone in its head.

name: Rolycoly
flavorText: Chunks of the surface of this Pokémon's body that have grown old and flaked off have long been used for fuel as an alternative to coal.

name: Carkol
flavorText: Due to the coal tar created inside it, the heap of coal on Carkol's back never falls apart, even when the Pokémon rolls around at high speeds.

name: Coalossal
flavorText: It's gentle usually but fearsome when angered. With a body that burns at over 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit, it crushes foes and turns them to ash.

name: Gastly
flavorText: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

name: Haunter
flavorText: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

name: Team Rocket's Murkrow
flavorText: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

name: Team Rocket's Honchkrow
flavorText: A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and more than 100 of its Murkrow cronies will assemble.

name: Poochyena
flavorText: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

name: Mightyena
flavorText: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

name: Galarian Zigzagoon
flavorText: Its restlessness has it constantly running around. If it sees another Pokémon, it will purposely run into them in order to start a fight.

name: Galarian Linoone
flavorText: It uses its long tongue to taunt opponents. Once the opposition is enraged, this Pokémon hurls itself at the opponent, tackling them forcefully.

name: Galarian Obstagoon
flavorText: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.

name: Cynthia's Spiritomb
flavorText: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

name: Scraggy
flavorText: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

name: N's Zorua
flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

name: Vullaby
flavorText: Its healthy appetite leads to visible growth spurts. It often has to replace the bones it wears as its size increases.

name: Pangoro
flavorText: Although it has a violent temperament, it won't put up with those who bully the weak. It senses foes' movements with its leaf.

name: Hoopa
flavorText: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.

name: Pecharunt
flavorText: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.

name: Mawile
flavorText: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

name: Pawniard
flavorText: Any chips in its blades would prove fatal for it. After each battle, it diligently maintains its blades using its favorite sharpening stone.

name: Bisharp
flavorText: Bisharp mercilessly cuts its opponents to pieces with the sharp blades covering its body. It will do anything to win.

name: Kingambit
flavorText: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it's not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.

name: Dratini
flavorText: This Pokémon is full of life energy. It continually sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.

name: Dragonair
flavorText: Its crystalline orbs appear to give this Pokémon the power to freely control the weather.

name: Rayquaza
flavorText: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

name: N's Reshiram
flavorText: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

name: N's Zekrom
flavorText: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings.

name: Noibat
flavorText: Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

name: Noivern
flavorText: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.

name: Dreepy
flavorText: It has a habit of biting at Clauncher even though it doesn't feed on them. This is said to be vestigial behavior from when Dreepy was alive.

name: Drakloak
flavorText: This Pokémon stores up energy in its lungs, then shoots it out. It takes care of Dreepy and battles alongside them until they're all grown up.

name: Team Rocket's Meowth
flavorText: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

name: Larry's Dunsparce
flavorText: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can float just slightly using its wings.

name: Skitty
flavorText: It can't stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

name: Delcatty
flavorText: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.

name: Larry's Starly
flavorText: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.

name: Larry's Staravia
flavorText: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.

name: Larry's Staraptor
flavorText: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.

name: Fan Rotom
flavorText: There are several appliances that Rotom can inspirit, but the first one to be developed was the electric fan.

name: Larry's Rufflet
flavorText: With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also consumes berries, it's a carnivore at heart.

name: Larry's Braviary
flavorText: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.

name: Larry's Komala
flavorText: A potent anesthetic can be made by diluting Komala's drool. This anesthetic was used for surgeries in the past.

name: Drampa
flavorText: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.

name: Hop's Cramorant
flavorText: Cramorant instinctively swallow everything whole. They're at their most formidable when they're struggling to swallow overly large prey.

name: Terapagos
flavorText: The shell is made of crystallized Terastal energy. When struck by a move, this shell absorbs the move's energy and transfers it to Terapagos.

name: Weedle
flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

name: Kakuna
flavorText: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

name: Carnivine
flavorText: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

name: Chespin
flavorText: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

name: Quilladin
flavorText: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won't start fights.

name: Chesnaught
flavorText: Its tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

name: Vulpix
flavorText: As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxurious coat of fur.

name: Ninetales
flavorText: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.

name: Ho-Oh
flavorText: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

name: Fennekin
flavorText: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Braixen
flavorText: It keeps a twig in its tail. Using friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.

name: Delphox
flavorText: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

name: Litleo
flavorText: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

name: Remoraid
flavorText: The water they shoot from their mouths can hit moving prey from more than 300 feet away.

name: Octillery
flavorText: Its instinct is to bury itself in holes. It often steals the nesting holes of others to sleep in them.

name: Delibird
flavorText: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has a habit of sharing food with people lost in the mountains.

name: Keldeo
flavorText: Keldeo has strengthened its resolve for battle, filling its body with power and changing its form.

name: Froakie
flavorText: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Frogadier
flavorText: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

name: Bergmite
flavorText: It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. If the ice breaks, this Pokémon uses cold air to quickly create new ice.

name: Avalugg
flavorText: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its enormous frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

name: Wimpod
flavorText: It's nature's cleaner—it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

name: Golisopod
flavorText: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

name: Mareep
flavorText: Its fluffy coat doubles in size when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

name: Flaaffy
flavorText: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. Flaaffy can fire wool that zaps on impact.

name: Ampharos
flavorText: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

name: Emolga
flavorText: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its patagial membranes and released while it is gliding.

name: Deoxys
flavorText: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

name: Espurr
flavorText: It keeps its intense psychic power from leaking out by using its ears to cover the organs emitting that power.

name: Meowstic
flavorText: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

name: Phantump
flavorText: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.

name: Trevenant
flavorText: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest. It's kind to the Pokémon that reside in its body.

name: Pumpkaboo
flavorText: It was recently discovered that the different varieties of Pumpkaboo vary not only in size but also in the size of the souls they collect.

name: Xerneas
flavorText: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

name: Sudowoodo
flavorText: To avoid being attacked, it does nothing but mimic a tree. It hates water and flees from rain.

name: Phanpy
flavorText: It is far stronger than it appears. If a Phanpy is swinging its trunk around and your arm gets hit by it, your arm bone will shatter.

name: Donphan
flavorText: Donphan is normally a calm Pokémon, but once it is enraged, it will curl its body into a ball and charge at you while rolling.

name: Baltoy
flavorText: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

name: Claydol
flavorText: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

name: Zubat
flavorText: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.

name: Golbat
flavorText: It loves to drink other creatures' blood. It's said that if it finds others of its kind going hungry, it sometimes shares the blood it's gathered.

name: Crobat
flavorText: Both of its legs have turned into wings. Without a sound, Crobat flies swiftly toward its prey and sinks its fangs into the nape of its target's neck.

name: Qwilfish
flavorText: Experienced fishers say they try to catch Qwilfish in the brief moment that these Pokémon become defenseless just after launching poisonous spikes.

name: Stunky
flavorText: The foul fluid from its rear is so revolting that it can make people feel queasy up to a mile and a quarter away.

name: Skuntank
flavorText: It attacks by spraying a repugnant fluid from its tail, but the stench dulls after a few squirts.

name: Trubbish
flavorText: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.

name: Garbodor
flavorText: Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.

name: Skrelp
flavorText: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, this Pokémon sprays liquid poison to take down prey that approach unawares.

name: Beldum
flavorText: They communicate with one another by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.

name: Metang
flavorText: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won't be scratched if it collides with a jet.

name: Metagross
flavorText: Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.

name: Ferroseed
flavorText: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

name: Ferrothorn
flavorText: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

name: Goomy
flavorText: Thanks to the slimy membrane covering its body, punches or kicks from its enemies slide right off it.

name: Sliggoo
flavorText: Its four horns are a high-performance radar system. It uses them to sense sounds and smells, rather than using ears or a nose.

name: Goodra
flavorText: This very friendly dragon Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

name: Tauros
flavorText: They fight each other by locking horns. The herd's protectors take pride in their battle-scarred horns.

name: Patrat
flavorText: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

name: Watchog
flavorText: Using luminescent matter within its body, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

name: Minccino
flavorText: These Pokémon like things neat and tidy. They are always sweeping and dusting their habitat, using their tails as brooms.

name: Bulbasaur
flavorText: For some time after its birth, it uses the nutrients that are packed into the seed on its back in order to grow.

name: Ivysaur
flavorText: The more sunlight Ivysaur bathes in, the more strength wells up within it, allowing the bud on its back to grow larger.

name: Exeggcute
flavorText: If you touch one of Exeggcute’s heads, mistaking it for an egg, the other heads will quickly gather and attack you in a swarm.

name: Exeggutor
flavorText: It is called the Walking Jungle. Each of the nuts has a face and a will of its own.

name: Tangela
flavorText: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.

name: Tangrowth
flavorText: Vine growth is accelerated for Tangrowth living in warm climates. If the vines grow long, Tangrowth shortens them by tearing parts of them off.

name: Meganium
flavorText: Anyone who stands beside it becomes refreshed, just as if they were soaking in the soothing atmosphere of a forest.

name: Shuckle
flavorText: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.

name: Celebi
flavorText: This Pokémon traveled through time to come from the future. It bolsters grass and trees with its own strength, and it can heal wounds, too.

name: Seedot
flavorText: To expand its habitat, it pretends to be a nut so that bird Pokémon will pick it up and carry it far away.

name: Nuzleaf
flavorText: It leads a quiet life deep in the forest. If anything wanders into its territory, Nuzleaf will warn the intruder by sounding its grass flute.

name: Shiftry
flavorText: It is said that when Shiftry flaps its leafy fans atop ancient trees, chilly winds blow and the season rolls into winter.

name: Nincada
flavorText: It can sometimes live underground for more than 10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees.

name: Ninjask
flavorText: This Pokémon is so quick, it is said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.

name: Dhelmise
flavorText: After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. It catches large Wailord and drains their life-force.

name: Pyroar
flavorText: The mane of a male Pyroar heats up to over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit during battle. Merely approaching it will cause severe burns.

name: Volcanion
flavorText: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

name: Cinderace
flavorText: Although Cinderace loses its cool easily, it will battle flawlessly for a Trainer it trusts.

name: Sizzlipede
flavorText: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

name: Centiskorch
flavorText: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

name: Chi-Yu
flavorText: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.

name: Mantine
flavorText: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if Remoraid attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.

name: Corphish
flavorText: It came from overseas. It is a very hardy creature that will quickly proliferate, even in polluted streams.

name: Kyogre
flavorText: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

name: Snover
flavorText: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain’s lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

name: Clauncher
flavorText: This Pokémon launches water by detonating gas inside its right claw. It snipes flying Pokémon.

name: Clawitzer
flavorText: Clawitzer can move through the water at a speed of 60 knots by using gas inside its body to expel water from the back of its claw.

name: Sobble
flavorText: It gets berries to eat by shooting them down with bullets of water it spurts from its mouth. Its aim is perfect.

name: Drizzile
flavorText: It extends its long, slimy tongue at blinding speeds and finishes off its prey with great skill.

name: Inteleon
flavorText: It uses special lenses in its eyes to sense things about its opponents—like their body heat—then attacks once it identifies a weak spot.

name: Eiscue
flavorText: On hot days, these Pokémon press their ice cube heads together and pass the time cooling each other down.

name: Magnemite
flavorText: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

name: Magneton
flavorText: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

name: Magnezone
flavorText: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin, while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

name: Raikou
flavorText: This rough Pokémon stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.

name: Electrike
flavorText: It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.

name: Pachirisu
flavorText: It’s one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.

name: Abra
flavorText: Abra can teleport in its sleep. Apparently the more deeply Abra sleeps, the farther its teleportations go.

name: Kadabra
flavorText: This Pokémon's telekinesis is immensely powerful. To prepare for evolution, Kadabra stores up psychic energy in the star on its forehead.

name: Alakazam
flavorText: Alakazam wields potent psychic powers. It's said that this Pokémon used these powers to create the spoons it holds.

name: Jynx
flavorText: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.

name: Shedinja
flavorText: A strange Pokémon—it flies without moving its wings, has a hollow shell for a body, and does not breathe.

name: Spoink
flavorText: Spoink will die if it stops bouncing. The pearl on its head amplifies its psychic powers.

name: Grumpig
flavorText: It can perform odd dance steps to influence foes. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

name: Greavard
flavorText: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.

name: Houndstone
flavorText: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

name: Gimmighoul
flavorText: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

name: Sandshrew
flavorText: It digs deep burrows to live in. When in danger, it rolls up its body to withstand attacks.

name: Sandslash
flavorText: It is adept at attacking with the spines on its back and its sharp claws while quickly scurrying about.

name: Onix
flavorText: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

name: Tyrogue
flavorText: This earnest Pokémon battles all sorts of opponents, searching for the fighting style that suits it best.

name: Makuhita
flavorText: It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a gutsy Pokémon that can withstand any attack.

name: Hariyama
flavorText: It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.

name: Croagunk
flavorText: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

name: Toxicroak
flavorText: Swaying and dodging the attacks of its foes, it weaves its flexible body in close, then lunges out with its poisonous claws.

name: Marshadow
flavorText: This Pokémon can conceal itself in any shadow, so it went undiscovered for a long time.

name: Stonjourner
flavorText: The elemental composition of the rocks that form its body were found to match the bedrock of a land far away from this Pokémon’s habitat.

name: Nacli
flavorText: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

name: Naclstack
flavorText: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey’s body.

name: Garganacl
flavorText: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

name: Crawdaunt
flavorText: Loving to battle, this Pokémon pinches all Pokémon that enter its territory with its pincers and throws them out.

name: Spiritomb
flavorText: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

name: Yveltal
flavorText: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

name: Nickit
flavorText: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.

name: Thievul
flavorText: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.

name: Shroodle
flavorText: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

name: Grafaiai
flavorText: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

name: Steelix
flavorText: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

name: Dialga
flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

name: Tinkatink
flavorText: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

name: Tinkatuff
flavorText: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

name: Tinkaton
flavorText: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

name: Gholdengo
flavorText: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins. This Pokémon gets along well with others and is quick to make friends with anybody.

name: Latios
flavorText: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

name: Spearow
flavorText: Due to its short wings, it can't fly long distances. It wanders about restlessly and pecks at bug Pokémon.

name: Fearow
flavorText: Carrying food through Fearow's territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!

name: Miltank
flavorText: This Pokémon needs to be milked every day, or else it will fall ill. The flavor of Miltank milk changes with the seasons.

name: Buneary
flavorText: Buneary can attack by rolling up their ears and then striking with the force created by unrolling them. This attack becomes stronger with training.

name: Lopunny
flavorText: Once hot seasons are over, Lopunny's coat will be replaced with fur that holds a lot of insulating air in preparation for colder weather.

name: Yungoos
flavorText: Its stomach fills most of its torso. It wanders the same path every day, searching for fresh food.

name: Gumshoos
flavorText: Once it finds signs of prey, it will patiently stake out the location, waiting until the sun goes down.

name: Stufful
flavorText: The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.

name: Bewear
flavorText: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

name: Tropius
flavorText: Delicious fruits grew out from around its neck because it always ate the same kind of fruit.

name: Fomantis
flavorText: Many Trainers give their Fomantis their own flowerpots so they can sunbathe in peace and quiet.

name: Poltchageist
flavorText: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

name: Sinistcha
flavorText: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

name: Heatran
flavorText: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

name: Charcadet
flavorText: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

name: Armarouge
flavorText: This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.

name: Goldeen
flavorText: Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the Water Dancer.

name: Seaking
flavorText: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.

name: Wailmer
flavorText: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

name: Relicanth
flavorText: Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.

name: Popplio
flavorText: The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger and larger as it practices day by day.

name: Brionne
flavorText: It cares deeply for its companions. When its Trainer is feeling down, it performs a cheery dance to try to help.

name: Primarina
flavorText: Also known as a songstress, it is a sight to behold on moonlit nights when it sings in front of the colony it leads.

name: Finizen
flavorText: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

name: Palafin
flavorText: This hero of the ocean swims at a speed of 50 knots and saves drowning people and Pokémon.

name: Manectric
flavorText: It discharges electricity from its mane. The Pokémon creates a thundercloud overhead from which to drop lightning bolts.

name: Miraidon
flavorText: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

name: Slowpoke
flavorText: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.

name: Slowbro
flavorText: An attached Shellder won't let go because of the tasty flavor that oozes out of Slowbro's tail.

name: Litwick
flavorText: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

name: Lampent
flavorText: Lampent appears at the moment of death and promptly absorbs the spirit as it leaves the body.

name: Annihilape
flavorText: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

name: Mankey
flavorText: It is extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next instant.

name: Primeape
flavorText: Some researchers theorize that Primeape remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.

name: Cranidos
flavorText: Cranidos toughen up their already sturdy heads by headbutting one another.

name: Drilbur
flavorText: By spinning its body, it can dig straight through the ground at a speed of 30 mph.

name: Koraidon
flavorText: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

name: Mandibuzz
flavorText: Watching from the sky, they attack weakened prey on the ground. They have a habit of decorating themselves with bones.

name: Inkay
flavorText: It drains foes' will to fight by flashing light at them. It then takes the opportunity to hide itself away.

name: Malamar
flavorText: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.

name: Zarude
flavorText: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It's incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.

name: Maschiff
flavorText: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

name: Mabosstiff
flavorText: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

name: Skarmory
flavorText: Because it nests in bramble bushes, the feathers of its chicks grow hard from being scratched by thorns.

name: Shieldon
flavorText: This Pokémon lived in primeval jungles. It's thought that Shieldon had few enemies thanks to its sturdy face.

name: Bastiodon
flavorText: Bastiodon live in herds. When assaulted by enemies, they line up side by side and use their hard faces to block attacks.

name: Bronzor
flavorText: They are found in ancient tombs. The patterns on their backs are said to be imbued with mysterious power.

name: Bronzong
flavorText: It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.

name: Pikipek
flavorText: Pikipek has strong muscles in its neck, so it won't hurt itself even if it violently shakes its head.

name: Trumbeak
flavorText: When it encounters foes, it launches the many seeds stored in its beak in a radial burst.

name: Toucannon
flavorText: Pairs of Toucannon are considered symbols of companionship, as these Pokémon will raise the temperature of their beaks to warm each other.

name: Type: Null
flavorText: It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth. The mask placed upon it limits its power in order to keep it under control.

name: Silvally
flavorText: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon's true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

name: Bombirdier
flavorText: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

name: Oddish
flavorText: Its scientific name is Oddium wanderus. It is said to cover distances as far as 1,000 feet when night falls, walking on its two roots.

name: Gloom
flavorText: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn’t drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

name: Vileplume
flavorText: The bud bursts into bloom with a bang. It then starts scattering allergenic, poisonous pollen.

name: Lotad
flavorText: The leaf on its head is naturally dirt repellent and will stay clean even after transporting Pokémon that are covered in mud.

name: Lombre
flavorText: It prefers waterfronts with plentiful food. It became nocturnal so it wouldn’t have to compete for food with bird Pokémon.

name: Ludicolo
flavorText: There are structures throughout its whole body that produce energy when hit by sound waves with a cheerful rhythm.

name: Genesect
flavorText: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

name: Nymble
flavorText: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it’s in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

name: Lokix
flavorText: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

name: Moltres
flavorText: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

name: Darumaka
flavorText: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it's pushed or pulled.

name: Darmanitan
flavorText: This Pokémon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Reshiram
flavorText: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

name: Ceruledge
flavorText: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

name: Seel
flavorText: The protrusion on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.

name: Dewgong
flavorText: It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during the day, then looks for food at night when it’s colder.

name: Swinub
flavorText: It searches for food by digging into the ground with its snout. Even frozen ground doesn't give it any trouble.

name: Piloswine
flavorText: Covered by a shaggy coat, it is resistant to the cold. Its tusks of ice thicken when it snows.

name: Mamoswine
flavorText: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

name: Suicune
flavorText: Said to be the reincarnation of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

name: Piplup
flavorText: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

name: Prinplup
flavorText: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees in half with a single hit.

name: Yamper
flavorText: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

name: Boltund
flavorText: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

name: Pawmi
flavorText: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

name: Pawmo
flavorText: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

name: Pawmot
flavorText: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

name: Snubbull
flavorText: In truth, it is a cowardly Pokémon. It growls eagerly in order to hide its fear from its opponent.

name: Granbull
flavorText: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If attacked, it desperately flails its limbs about in an attempt to repel its opponent.

name: Cresselia
flavorText: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Meloetta
flavorText: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

name: Mimikyu
flavorText: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

name: Milcery
flavorText: The more sweet aromas it absorbs, the more its body swells. Milcery will deflate when its energy level drops.

name: Alcremie
flavorText: Desserts that Alcremie have decorated with their cream have a rich, sweet flavor and bring happiness to all who eat them.

name: Zacian
flavorText: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

name: Bramblin
flavorText: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

name: Brambleghast
flavorText: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

name: Paldean Tauros
flavorText: This Pokémon has a muscular body and excels at close-quarters combat. It uses its short horns to strike the opponent's weak spots.

name: Gligar
flavorText: It builds its nest on a steep cliff. When it is done gliding, it hops along the ground back to its nest.

name: Gliscor
flavorText: If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once.

name: Trapinch
flavorText: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It patiently awaits prey inside its funnel-shaped nest.

name: Vibrava
flavorText: Rather than using its underdeveloped wings for flight, it rubs them together, emitting ultrasonic waves to attack its enemies.

name: Flygon
flavorText: Known as the Desert Spirit, this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

name: Murkrow
flavorText: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

name: Honchkrow
flavorText: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

name: Sableye
flavorText: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

name: Carvanha
flavorText: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

name: Seviper
flavorText: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

name: Absol
flavorText: Because of this Pokémon's ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

name: Sandile
flavorText: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.

name: Krokorok
flavorText: Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see even in the dead of night. They live in groups of a few individuals.

name: Krookodile
flavorText: After clamping down with its powerful jaws, it twists its body around to rip its prey in half.

name: Toxel
flavorText: It has no problem drinking dirty water. An organ inside Toxel's body filters such water into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.

name: Toxtricity
flavorText: As it scatters toxic sweat and emits electricity, a melody that sounds like it came from a guitar reverberates through the surrounding area.

name: Eternatus
flavorText: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

name: Togedemaru
flavorText: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

name: Duraludon
flavorText: Duraludon’s body is comprised of a special metal that’s lightweight and scratch resistant. It’s also smooth, as though it was given a mirror finish.

name: Archaludon
flavorText: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful.

name: Jigglypuff
flavorText: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

name: Wigglytuff
flavorText: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

name: Aipom
flavorText: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

name: Ambipom
flavorText: They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.

name: Smeargle
flavorText: Once a Smeargle reaches adulthood, it will have other members of its species leave paw prints on its back.

name: Zigzagoon
flavorText: A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigzags.

name: Linoone
flavorText: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.

name: Paldean Wooper
flavorText: It's dangerous for Wooper to travel alone. They line up in groups of three or four and help each other as they walk around the wetlands.

name: Meowth
flavorText: It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny object, the gold coin on its head shines, too.

name: Spinarak
flavorText: It spins a web using fine yet durable thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.

name: Ariados
flavorText: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It's hard to tell which end is which.

name: Shaymin
flavorText: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

name: Snivy
flavorText: It prefers to avoid groups. In its day-to-day life, it dexterously controls its vines to compensate for its short arms.

name: Servine
flavorText: Servine's one weakness is its inflated sense of pride. It takes a while for Servine to be able to cooperate with other Pokémon.

name: Serperior
flavorText: An intimidating gaze and majestic appearance have caused this Pokémon to be known as the Lord of the Forest.

name: Scatterbug
flavorText: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

name: Spewpa
flavorText: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.

name: Vivillon
flavorText: The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the climate and topography of the land it was born in. This form is from lands where flowers bloom.

name: Rowlet
flavorText: It feels relaxed in tight, dark places and has been known to nestle into its Trainer's bag or the front of their jacket.

name: Dartrix
flavorText: It throws sharp feathers called blade quills at enemies or prey. It seldom misses.

name: Fletchinder
flavorText: The hotter the flame sac in its belly, the faster it can fly, but it takes some time to get the fire going.

name: Talonflame
flavorText: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers as it flies.

name: Turtonator
flavorText: Explosive substances coat the shell on its back. Enemies that dare attack it will be blown away by an immense detonation.

name: Staryu
flavorText: Even if its body is torn, it can regenerate as long as the glowing central core remains intact.

name: Amaura
flavorText: This ancient Pokémon was restored from a part of its body that had been frozen in ice for 100 million years.

name: Aurorus
flavorText: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.

name: Shinx
flavorText: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. Its fur glows when it's in trouble.

name: Luxio
flavorText: By gathering their tails together, they collectively generate powerful electricity from their claws.

name: Luxray
flavorText: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

name: Dedenne
flavorText: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

name: Spritzee
flavorText: In the past, rather than using perfume, royal ladies carried a Spritzee that would waft a fragrance they liked.

name: Aromatisse
flavorText: Its scent is so overpowering that, unless they happen to really enjoy the smell, Trainers will have a hard time walking alongside it.

name: Nosepass
flavorText: When endangered, it may protect itself by increasing its magnetism and drawing nearby iron objects to its body.

name: Probopass
flavorText: Probopass radiates such a powerful magnetic field that nearby electrical appliances are rendered useless while it's around.

name: Hippopotas
flavorText: It enshrouds itself with sand to protect itself from germs. It does not enjoy getting wet.

name: Hippowdon
flavorText: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

name: Landorus
flavorText: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

name: Binacle
flavorText: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.

name: Barbaracle
flavorText: Barbaracle's legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head's orders.

name: Tyrunt
flavorText: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn't like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.

name: Tyrantrum
flavorText: This Pokémon behaved like a king 100 million years ago. Nothing could stop it.

name: Hawlucha
flavorText: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. It likes to attack from above, a maneuver that is difficult to defend against.

name: Gengar
flavorText: It hides in shadows. It is said that in rooms where Gengar is hiding, the temperature drops by nearly 10 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Skorupi
flavorText: After burrowing into the sand, it waits patiently for prey to come near. This Pokémon and Sizzlipede share common descent.

name: Drapion
flavorText: Its poison is potent, but it rarely sees use. This Pokémon prefers to use physical force instead, going on rampages with its car-crushing strength.

name: Chien-Pao
flavorText: The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.

name: Honedge
flavorText: Apparently Honedge was born when a departed spirit began inhabiting an ancient sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

name: Doublade
flavorText: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords that cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.

name: Aegislash
flavorText: This stance is dedicated to offense. It can cleave any opponent with the strength and weight of its steel blade.

name: Klefki
flavorText: It never lets go of a key that it likes, so people give it the keys to vaults and safes as a way to prevent crime.

name: Rattata
flavorText: Its incisors grow continuously throughout its life. If its incisors get too long, this Pokémon becomes unable to eat, and it starves to death.

name: Raticate
flavorText: People say that it fled from its enemies by using its small webbed hind feet to swim from island to island in Alola.

name: Snorlax
flavorText: Its stomach's digestive juices can dissolve any kind of poison. Eating things off the ground doesn't bother it at all.

name: Bunnelby
flavorText: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through without rest.

name: Diggersby
flavorText: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.

name: Fletchling
flavorText: Despite the beauty of its lilting voice, it's merciless to intruders that enter its territory.

name: Furfrou
flavorText: Historically, in the Kalos region, these Pokémon were the designated guardians of the king.

name: Pineco
flavorText: It spits out a fluid that it uses to glue tree bark to its body. The fluid hardens when it touches air.

name: Heracross
flavorText: With its herculean powers, it can easily throw around an object that is 100 times its own weight.

name: Shroomish
flavorText: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

name: Breloom
flavorText: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

name: Cacnea
flavorText: It prefers harsh environments, such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

name: Cacturne
flavorText: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.

name: Skiddo
flavorText: Until recently, people living in the mountains would ride on the back of these Pokémon to traverse the mountain paths.

name: Gogoat
flavorText: It can sense the feelings of others by touching them with its horns. This species has assisted people with their work since 5,000 years ago.

name: Sprigatito
flavorText: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

name: Floragato
flavorText: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

name: Meowscarada
flavorText: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

name: Tarountula
flavorText: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon's natural enemy.

name: Smoliv
flavorText: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

name: Dolliv
flavorText: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

name: Arboliva
flavorText: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

name: Toedscool
flavorText: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

name: Toedscruel
flavorText: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

name: Capsakid
flavorText: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

name: Scovillain
flavorText: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

name: Growlithe
flavorText: It's very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

name: Houndour
flavorText: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

name: Houndoom
flavorText: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

name: Torkoal
flavorText: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

name: Fuecoco
flavorText: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco's head and flickers to and fro.

name: Crocalor
flavorText: The valve in Crocalor's flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

name: Skeledirge
flavorText: Skeledirge's gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Magikarp
flavorText: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

name: Buizel
flavorText: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

name: Floatzel
flavorText: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

name: Alomomola
flavorText: It gently holds injured and weak Pokémon in its fins. Its special membrane heals their wounds.

name: Bruxish
flavorText: It grinds its teeth with great force to stimulate its brain. It fires the psychic energy created by this process from the protuberance on its head.

name: Quaxly
flavorText: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

name: Quaxwell
flavorText: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

name: Quaquaval
flavorText: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.

name: Wiglett
flavorText: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

name: Wugtrio
flavorText: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

name: Cetoddle
flavorText: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

name: Cetitan
flavorText: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

name: Dondozo
flavorText: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.

name: Tatsugiri
flavorText: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

name: Wattrel
flavorText: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

name: Kilowattrel
flavorText: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

name: Drowzee
flavorText: When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.

name: Hypno
flavorText: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.

name: Drifloon
flavorText: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

name: Drifblim
flavorText: It can generate and release gas within its body. That's how it can control the altitude of its drift.

name: Flabébé
flavorText: This Flabébé rides a red flower. Immediately after birth, this Pokémon begins flying around in search of a flower it likes.

name: Floette
flavorText: This Pokémon uses red wavelengths of light to pour its own energy into flowers and draw forth their latent potential.

name: Florges
flavorText: They say that flower gardens created by Florges are constantly showered with a power that can heal both body and spirit.

name: Fidough
flavorText: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

name: Dachsbun
flavorText: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

name: Flittle
flavorText: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

name: Espathra
flavorText: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.

name: Lucario
flavorText: It's said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras—even those of foes it could not otherwise see.

name: Silicobra
flavorText: Silicobra's neck pouch, which can inflate and deflate like a balloon, gets more elastic each time Silicobra sheds its skin.

name: Sandaconda
flavorText: It will expand its body as much as it can and then contract itself, blasting out sand with enough force to wash away a dump truck.

name: Klawf
flavorText: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

name: Grimer
flavorText: Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.

name: Muk
flavorText: It's thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

name: Forretress
flavorText: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.

name: Varoom
flavorText: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

name: Revavroom
flavorText: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.

name: Chansey
flavorText: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.

name: Blissey
flavorText: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

name: Zangoose
flavorText: It's Seviper's archrival. To threaten those it encounters, it fans out the claws on its front paws.

name: Starly
flavorText: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

name: Staravia
flavorText: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.

name: Staraptor
flavorText: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

name: Skwovet
flavorText: No matter how much it stuffs its belly with food, it is always anxious about getting hungry again. So, it stashes berries in its cheeks and tail.

name: Greedent
flavorText: This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen berries by wrapping them in its tail, which is roughly twice the length of its body.

name: Indeedee
flavorText: In search of happy feelings—such as joy and gratitude—Indeedee bustles around, taking diligent care of people and other Pokémon.

name: Lechonk
flavorText: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.

name: Oinkologne
flavorText: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.

name: Tandemaus
flavorText: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

name: Maushold
flavorText: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

name: Squawkabilly
flavorText: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they're out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

name: Cyclizar
flavorText: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

name: Flamigo
flavorText: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as "synchronizing," an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.
